transcript.text: This is the first show that they're all gathering here. I'm not sure if I could say it out loud. Just say it. / Say it.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ディス・イズ・ザ・ファースト・ショー・ザット・ゼア・オール・ギャザリング・ヒア・アイム・ノット・シュア・イフ・アイ・クッド・セイ・イット・アウト・ラウド・ジャスト・セイ・イット・セイ・イット
transcript.pronunciation_roman: This is the first show that they 're all gathering here . I 'm not sure if I could say it out loud . Just say it . / Say it .

translations.ja: 全員がここに集まるのはこれが初めての番組なんです。声に出して言っていいか分からないんですけど。／言っちゃいなよ。／言って。
translations.en: This is the first show that they're all gathering here. I'm not sure if I could say it out loud. Just say it. / Say it.
translations.ko: 다 같이 모이는 건 이번 프로그램이 처음이에요. 큰소리로 말해도 될지 모르겠네요. 그냥 말해버려요. / 말해요.
translations.zh-TW: 這是他們第一次全部聚在這裡的節目。我不確定我能不能大聲說出來。說出來吧。／說吧。
translations.id: Ini adalah pertunjukan pertama di mana mereka berkumpul di sini. Aku tidak yakin apakah aku bisa mengatakannya dengan lantang. Ucapkan saja. / Katakan saja.
translations.pt: Este é o primeiro programa em que todos eles estão reunidos aqui. Não sei se posso dizer isso em voz alta. Apenas diga. / Diga.

transcript.text: Okay, okay. I'm anticipating. I smelled something weird. / Smell it?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: オーケー・オーケー・アイム・アンティシペイティング・アイ・スメルド・サムシング・ウィアード・スメル・イット
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Okay , okay . I 'm anticipating . I smelled something weird . / Smell it ?

translations.ja: オッケー、オッケー。楽しみにしてるよ。なんか変な匂いがしたんだけど。／匂う？
translations.en: Okay, okay. I'm anticipating. I smelled something weird. / Smell it?
translations.ko: 그래요, 좋아요. 기대되네요. 이상한 냄새가 났어요. / 냄새를 맡았다고요?
translations.zh-TW: 好啦，好啦。我很期待。我聞到奇怪的味道了。／聞到嗎？
translations.id: Baiklah, baiklah. Aku menantikannya. Aku mencium bau sesuatu yang aneh. / Menciumnya?
translations.pt: Ok, ok. Estou ansioso. Senti um cheiro estranho. / Sentiu o cheiro?

transcript.text: I asked 'did you fart?' Nope. I just pooped. I didn't fart, I just pooped.

translations.en: I asked 'did you fart?' Nope. I just pooped. I didn't fart, I just pooped.
translations.ko: '방귀 뀌었어?'라고 물어봤죠. 아니요. 그냥 똥 쌌어요. 방귀 뀐 게 아니라 그냥 똥 쌌다고요.

translations.pt: Eu perguntei 'você peidou?' Não. Eu só caguei. Eu não peidei, eu só caguei.

transcript.text: The rule is that the first person will listen to the songs. After he's done, he'll give clues to his friends by dancing. Then the last person needs to guess the name of the songs.

transcript.pronunciation_roman: The rule is that the first person will listen to the songs . After he 's done , he 'll give clues to his friends by dancing . Then the last person needs to guess the name of the songs .

translations.ja: ルールは、最初の人が曲を聴きます。聴き終わったら、ダンスで仲間にヒントを出します。そして最後の人が曲名を当てるというものです。
translations.en: The rule is that the first person will listen to the songs. After he's done, he'll give clues to his friends by dancing. Then the last person needs to guess the name of the songs.
translations.ko: 규칙은 첫 번째 사람이 노래를 듣는 거예요. 다 듣고 나면 춤으로 친구들에게 힌트를 주는 거죠. 그리고 마지막 사람은 노래 제목을 맞춰야 해요.
translations.zh-TW: 規則是第一個人會聽歌。結束後，他會透過跳舞給朋友提示。然後最後一個人需要猜出歌名。
translations.id: Aturannya adalah orang pertama akan mendengarkan lagu-lagunya. Setelah selesai, dia akan memberikan petunjuk kepada teman-temannya dengan menari. Kemudian orang terakhir harus menebak judul lagunya.
translations.pt: A regra é que a primeira pessoa ouvirá as músicas. Quando terminar, dará dicas aos amigos através da dança. Então a última pessoa precisa adivinhar o nome das músicas.

transcript.text: I know! Wait! Answer it. / What's the song? What's the name of the song?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アイ・ノウ・ウェイト・アンサー・イット・ワッツ・ザ・ソング・ワッツ・ザ・ネーム・オブ・ザ・ソング
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I know ! Wait ! Answer it . / What 's the song ? What 's the name of the song ?

translations.ja: 分かった！待って！答えて！／何の曲？曲名は何？
translations.en: I know! Wait! Answer it. / What's the song? What's the name of the song?
translations.ko: 알아요! 잠깐만요! 맞춰볼게요. / 어떤 노래예요? 노래 제목이 뭔데요?
translations.zh-TW: 我知道！等等！回答它。／是什麼歌？歌名是什麼？

translations.en: This is the first show that they're here together for a special occasion. They are WAIOR.
translations.ko: 특별한 날을 맞아 이들이 함께 모인 건 이번이 처음이에요. 이들은 WAIOR입니다.

translations.ko: 각자 자신만의 관능적인 스타일을 보여줬죠. 다 직접 고른 거예요. / 네, 맞아요. 진심이에요? / 네.

translations.id: Masing-masing dari mereka menunjukkan gaya sensual mereka sendiri. Kamu memilih semuanya sendiri. / Ya, benar sekali. Apakah kamu serius? / Ya.
translations.pt: Cada um deles mostrou seus próprios estilos sensuais. Você escolheu todos eles sozinho. / Sim, é isso mesmo. Você está falando sério? / Sim.

transcript.text: What is it like when you're working together as WAIOR? You need to tell us something about your bandmates.

translations.pt: Como é trabalhar junto como WAIOR? Vocês precisam nos contar algo sobre seus colegas de banda.

translations.en: Why did you pick it up? Spill some tea, come on. I choose Daou. / Spill some tea about him.
translations.ko: 왜 그걸 집어 들어요? 썰 좀 풀어봐요, 자. 난 다우를 고르겠어요. / 그에 대한 썰을 풀어주세요.

translations.id: Kenapa kamu mengambilnya? Bongkar rahasianya, ayo. Aku memilih Daou. / Bongkar rahasia tentang dia.
translations.pt: Por que você pegou isso? Conta as fofofas, vamos lá. Eu escolho o Daou. / Conta uma fofoca sobre ele.

translations.ja: すごくエネルギッシュで、その場を明るくしてくれるんだよ。彼のことどう思った？おしゃべりすぎるって思った？

translations.ko: 에너지가 넘치고 분위기를 환하게 밝혀주더라고요. 그에 대해 어떻게 생각하나요? 말이 너무 많나요?

translations.pt: Ele não precisava ser tão formal comigo. / Não precisa focar na idade. Sério? Te chamei de P'Jung por tanto tempo.

transcript.text: What's up? / You didn't tell me that. You want to tell something to them? / I wouldn't dare call him just by his name.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ワッツ・アップ・ユー・ディドゥント・テル・ミー・ザット・ユー・ウォント・トゥ・テル・サムシング・トゥ・ゼム・アイ・ウドゥント・デア・コール・ヒム・ジャスト・バイ・ヒズ・ネーム
transcript.pronunciation_roman: What 's up ? / You didn 't tell me that . You want to tell something to them ? / I wouldn 't dare call him just by his name .

translations.ja: どうしたの？／そんなこと教えてくれなかったじゃん。みんなに何か言いたいことある？／呼び捨てになんて恐れ多くてできないよ。
translations.en: What's up? / You didn't tell me that. You want to tell something to them? / I wouldn't dare call him just by his name.
translations.ko: 무슨 일이야? / 그런 말 안 했잖아. 멤버들한테 하고 싶은 말 있어요? / 감히 이름을 그냥 부르지는 못하겠어요.
translations.zh-TW: 怎麼了？／你沒跟我說過這個。你想跟他們說什麼嗎？／我才不敢直接叫他的名字。
translations.id: Ada apa? / Kamu tidak memberitahuku itu. Kamu ingin menceritakan sesuatu kepada mereka? / Aku tidak akan berani memanggilnya hanya dengan namanya.
translations.pt: E aí? / Você não me disse isso. Quer contar algo para eles? / Eu não ousaria chamá-lo apenas pelo nome.

transcript.text: You just did. Nice, go on. / Well, I need to talk about Porsche.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ユー・ジャスト・ディド・ナイス・ゴー・オン・ウェル・アイ・ニード・トゥ・トーク・アバウト・ポルシェ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: You just did . Nice , go on . / Well , I need to talk about Porsche .

translations.ja: 今したじゃん。いいね、続けて。／えっと、ポルシェについて話さないとね。
translations.en: You just did. Nice, go on. / Well, I need to talk about Porsche.
translations.ko: 방금 불렀잖아. 나이스, 계속해봐요. / 음, 포쉬에 대해 얘기해야겠네요.
translations.zh-TW: 你剛剛就這樣做了。Nice，繼續。／嗯，我得談談 Porsche。
translations.id: Kamu baru saja melakukannya. Nice, lanjutkan. / Nah, aku harus membicarakan tentang Porsche.
translations.pt: Você acabou de fazer isso. Nice, continue. / Bem, eu preciso falar sobre o Porsche.

transcript.text: I love you, bro. / Okay, my beloved bro. I haven't seen him in such a long time, right? / That's right.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アイ・ラブ・ユー・ブロ・オーケー・マイ・ビラヴド・ブロ・アイ・ハブント・シーン・ヒム・イン・サッチ・ア・ロング・タイム・ライト・ザッツ・ライト
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I love you , bro . / Okay , my beloved bro . I haven 't seen him in such a long time , right ? / That 's right .

translations.ja: 大好きだよ、兄弟。／はいはい、愛しの兄弟ね。彼とはすごく久しぶりに会ったんだよね？／そうそう。
translations.en: I love you, bro. / Okay, my beloved bro. I haven't seen him in such a long time, right? / That's right.
translations.ko: 사랑한다, 브로. / 그래, 사랑하는 내 브로. 얘 못 본 지 엄청 오래됐죠? / 맞아요.
translations.zh-TW: 我愛你，兄弟。／好的，我親愛的兄弟。我好久沒見到他了，對吧？／沒錯。
translations.id: Aku mencintaimu, bro. / Baiklah, saudaraku tercinta. Aku sudah sangat lama tidak melihatnya, kan? / Betul sekali.
translations.pt: Eu te amo, mano. / Ok, meu mano querido. Faz tanto tempo que não o vejo, né? / É verdade.

transcript.text: People would see him as a cool and romantic person. Are you about to say something bad about me. / Nope.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ピープル・ウドゥ・シー・ヒム・アズ・ア・クール・アンド・ロマンティック・パーソン・アー・ユー・アバウト・トゥ・セイ・サムシング・バッド・アバウト・ミー・ノープ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: People would see him as a cool and romantic person . Are you about to say something bad about me . / Nope .

translations.ja: みんなからはクールでロマンチックな人に見られてるよね。／僕の悪口でも言おうとしてる？／ううん、違うよ。
translations.en: People would see him as a cool and romantic person. Are you about to say something bad about me. / Nope.
translations.ko: 사람들은 쟤를 멋지고 로맨틱한 사람으로 볼 거예요. 내 욕하려는 거 아니지? / 아니요.
translations.zh-TW: 大家會覺得他是一個冷酷又浪漫的人。你是不是要說我的壞話？／沒有。
translations.id: Orang-orang akan melihatnya sebagai orang yang keren dan romantis. Apakah kamu akan mengatakan hal buruk tentang dariku. / Tidak.
translations.pt: As pessoas o veriam como uma pessoa legal e romântica. Você vai dizer algo ruim sobre mim? / Não.

transcript.text: I know him for what he truly is. I feel like he is a fun person to be with, and he is nicer than you think.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アイ・ノウ・ヒム・フォー・ワット・ヒー・トゥルーリー・イズ・アイ・フィール・ライク・ヒー・イズ・ア・ファン・パーソン・トゥ・ビー・ウィズ・アンド・ヒー・イズ・ナイサー・ザン・ユー・シンク
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I know him for what he truly is . I feel like he is a fun person to be with , and he is nicer than you think .

translations.ja: 僕は彼の本当の姿を知ってるんだ。一緒にいて楽しい人だし、みんなが思ってる以上にずっと優しいんだよ。
translations.en: I know him for what he truly is. I feel like he is a fun person to be with, and he is nicer than you think.
translations.ko: 난 쟤의 진짜 모습을 알아요. 같이 있으면 재밌는 사람이고, 생각보다 훨씬 다정한 사람이에요.
translations.zh-TW: 我了解他真實的樣子。我覺得和他在一起很有趣，而且他比你想的還要好。
translations.id: Aku mengenalnya apa adanya. Aku merasa dia adalah orang yang menyenangkan untuk diajak bersama, dan dia lebih baik dari yang kamu kira.
translations.pt: Eu o conheço de verdade. Sinto que ele é uma pessoa divertida de se conviver e é mais legal do que você pensa.

transcript.text: He tries to keep his cool look when he's in front of a camera.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ヒー・トライズ・トゥ・キープ・ヒズ・クール・ルック・ウェン・ヒーズ・イン・フロント・オブ・ア・カメラ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: He tries to keep his cool look when he 's in front of a camera .

translations.ja: カメラの前にいるときは、クールな見た目をキープしようとしてるだけなんだよね。
translations.en: He tries to keep his cool look when he's in front of a camera.
translations.ko: 카메라 앞에만 서면 시크한 모습을 유지하려고 하죠.
translations.zh-TW: 他在鏡頭前總是試圖保持冷酷的樣子。
translations.id: Dia mencoba mempertahankan penampilan tenangnya saat berada di depan kamera.
translations.pt: Ele tenta manter a marra de durão quando está na frente de uma câmera.

transcript.text: Since the shooting day I joked around with everyone and he kept laughing to himself. When I talked to him, he'd act cool like this.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: シンス・ザ・シューティング・デイ・アイ・ジョークト・アラウンド・ウィズ・エヴリワン・アンド・ヒー・ケプト・ラフィング・トゥ・ヒムセルフ・ウェン・アイ・トークト・トゥ・ヒム・ヒード・アクト・クール・ライク・ディス
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Since the shooting day I joked around with everyone and he kept laughing to himself . When I talked to him , he 'd act cool like this .

translations.ja: 撮影の日からずっと僕がみんなとふざけ合ってたら、彼ひとりだけずっと笑ってたんだ。僕から話しかけると、こんなふうにクールぶるんだよ。
translations.en: Since the shooting day I joked around with everyone and he kept laughing to himself. When I talked to him, he'd act cool like this.
translations.ko: 촬영 날부터 다들 농담을 주고받는데 혼자 키득거리더라고요. 내가 말 걸면 이렇게 시크한 척을 해요.
translations.zh-TW: 從拍攝當天起，我就和大家開玩笑，而他一直在自己偷笑。當我跟他聊天時，他就會裝酷，像這樣。
translations.id: Sejak hari syuting, aku bercanda dengan semua orang dan dia terus tertawa sendiri. Saat aku berbicara dengannya, dia akan bersikap keren seperti ini.
translations.pt: Desde o dia da gravação, eu brinquei com todo mundo e ele ficava rindo sozinho. Quando eu falava com ele, ele agia com marra assim.

transcript.text: He's always like this. It's not your turn. He's so nice and cute. Can we see this side of Porsche? He keeps his cool look when camera's around.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ヒーズ・オールウェイズ・ライク・ディス・イッツ・ノット・ユア・ターン・ヒーズ・ソー・ナイス・アンド・キュート・キャン・ウィー・シー・ディス・サイド・オブ・ポルシェ・ヒー・キープス・ヒズ・クール・ルック・ウェン・カメラズ・アラウンド
transcript.pronunciation_roman: He 's always like this . It 's not your turn . He 's so nice and cute . Can we see this side of Porsche ? He keeps his cool look when camera 's around .

translations.ja: いつもこんな感じだよ。まだ君の番じゃないでしょ。すごく優しくてかわいいんだ。ポルシェのそういう一面も見られるかな？カメラが回ってるとクールな表情を崩さないんだよね。
translations.en: He's always like this. It's not your turn. He's so nice and cute. Can we see this side of Porsche? He keeps his cool look when camera's around.
translations.ko: 항상 이래요. 네 차례 아니야. 정말 다정하고 귀여운 친구예요. 포쉬의 이런 모습을 볼 수 있을까요? 카메라도 없는데 시크한 척하네.
translations.zh-TW: 他一直都這樣。還沒輪到你。他人很好又可愛。我們能看到 Porsche 這一面嗎？鏡頭在的時候他總是保持冷酷。
translations.id: Dia selalu seperti ini. Ini bukan giliranmu. Dia sangat baik dan imut. Bisakah kita melihat sisi Porsche ini? Dia mempertahankan penampilan tenangnya saat kamera menyala.
translations.pt: Ele é sempre assim. Não é a sua vez. Ele é tão legal e fofo. Podemos ver esse lado do Porsche? Ele fica bancando o durão quando a câmera está por perto.

transcript.text: You'll see it today. / Nope, you can't. You're trying to get people to call me cute. I know what you're trying to do.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ユール・シー・イット・トゥデイ・ノープ・ユー・キャント・ユア・トライング・トゥ・ゲット・ピープル・トゥ・コール・ミー・キュート・アイ・ノウ・ワット・ユア・トライング・トゥ・ドゥ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: You 'll see it today . / Nope , you can 't. You 're trying to get people to call me cute . I know what you 're trying to do .

translations.ja: 今日見られるよ。／ いや、見せないよ。みんなに僕のことをかわいいって言わせようとしてるでしょ。何を企んでるかお見通しだからね。
translations.en: You'll see it today. / Nope, you can't. You're trying to get people to call me cute. I know what you're trying to do.
translations.ko: 오늘 보게 될 거예요. / 아니요, 못 봐요. 사람들이 나보고 귀엽다고 하게 만들려는 거 다 알아요. 무슨 수작인지 안다고요.
translations.zh-TW: 你今天就會看到了。／不，你看不到。你想讓大家叫我可愛。我知道你想幹嘛。
translations.id: Kamu akan melihatnya hari ini. / Tidak, kamu tidak bisa. Kamu mencoba membuat orang memanggilku imut. Aku tahu apa yang kamu coba lakukan.
translations.pt: Vocês vão ver hoje. / Não, não vão. Você está tentando fazer as pessoas me acham fofo. Eu sei o que você está tentando fazer.

transcript.text: I know your plan. / Well, I like it. Here's my excuse. I joke around with everyone, but I don't talk much.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アイ・ノウ・ユア・プラン・ウェル・アイ・ライク・イット・ヒアズ・マイ・エクスキューズ・アイ・ジョーク・アラウンド・ウィズ・エヴリワン・バット・アイ・ドント・トーク・マッチ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I know your plan . / Well , I like it . Here 's my excuse . I joke around with everyone , but I don 't talk much .

translations.ja: 作戦はお見通しだよ。／ まあ、僕は好きだけどね。一応言い訳させてもらうと、みんなとふざけたりはするけど、あんまりおしゃべりな方じゃないんだよ。
translations.en: I know your plan. / Well, I like it. Here's my excuse. I joke around with everyone, but I don't talk much.
translations.ko: 네 작전 다 알아요. / 음, 난 마음에 드는데. 변명하자면요. 다들 장난을 치는데 전 말을 많이 안 해요.
translations.zh-TW: 我知道你的計劃。／好吧，我喜歡。這是我的藉口。我跟每個人都開玩笑，但我話不多。
translations.id: Aku tahu rencanamu. / Nah, aku menyukainya. Ini alasanku. Aku bercanda dengan semua orang, tetapi aku tidak banyak bicara.
translations.pt: Eu conheço seu plano. / Bem, eu gosto. Aqui está minha desculpa. Eu brinco com todo mundo, mas não falo muito.

transcript.text: So you'd prefer to be quiet? / I don't know what to say. I've been here for such a long time. / Daou, spill some tea.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ソー・ユード・プリファー・トゥ・ビー・クワイエット・アイ・ドント・ノウ・ワット・トゥ・セイ・アイヴ・ビーン・ヒア・フォー・サッチ・ア・ロング・タイム・ダーオ・スピル・サム・ティー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: So you 'd prefer to be quiet ? / I don 't know what to say . I 've been here for such a long time . / Daou , spill some tea .

translations.ja: じゃあ静かにしてる方が好きなの？／ 何て言えばいいかわからないんだ。ずっとここにいるからね。／ ダーオ、何か暴露話してよ。
translations.en: So you'd prefer to be quiet? / I don't know what to say. I've been here for such a long time. / Daou, spill some tea.
translations.ko: 그럼 조용히 있는 걸 선호한다는 건가요? / 뭐라고 해야 할지 모르겠어요. 여기 있은 지 너무 오래돼서. / 다우, 썰 좀 풀어봐요.
translations.zh-TW: 所以你寧願安靜？／我不知道該說什麼。我來這裡很久了。／Daou，爆料一下。
translations.id: Jadi kamu lebih suka diam? / Aku tidak tahu harus berkata apa. Aku sudah berada di sini begitu lama. / Daou, bongkar rahasianya.
translations.pt: Então você prefere ficar calado? / Eu não sei o que dizer. Estou aqui há tanto tempo. / Daou, solta o verbo.

transcript.text: Porsche, I think. / Go on. It's fun to tease him. / Please be seated. It's gonna be fun. / No!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ポルシェ・アイ・シンク・ゴー・オン・イッツ・ファン・トゥ・ティーズ・ヒム・プリーズ・ビー・シーテッド・イッツ・ゴナ・ビー・ファン・ノー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Porsche , I think . / Go on . It 's fun to tease him . / Please be seated . It 's gonna be fun . / No !

translations.ja: ポルシェのことかな。／ どうぞどうぞ。彼をからかうの楽しいんだよね。／ 席についてください。面白くなりそう。／ やめて！
translations.en: Porsche, I think. / Go on. It's fun to tease him. / Please be seated. It's gonna be fun. / No!
translations.ko: 포쉬인 것 같아요. / 계속해봐요. 얘 놀리는 거 재밌단 말이야. / 자리에 앉아주세요. 재밌어질 거예요. / 안 돼요!
translations.zh-TW: 我覺得是 Porsche。／說吧。捉弄他很有趣。／請就座。這會很有趣的。／不要！
translations.id: Porsche, kurasa. / Lanjutkan. Menyenangkan untuk menggodanya. / Silakan duduk. Ini akan menjadi seru. / Tidak!
translations.pt: Porsche, eu acho. / Continue. É divertido provocá-lo. / Por favor, sentem-se. Vai ser divertido. / Não!

transcript.text: I can talk about all of them, I like their characters. Just one. / Nice likes to tease people. He just did it earlier.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アイ・キャン・トーク・アバウト・オール・オブ・ゼム・アイ・ライク・ゼア・キャラクターズ・ジャスト・ワン・ナイス・ライクス・トゥ・ティーズ・ピープル・ヒー・ジャスト・ディド・イット・アーリアー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I can talk about all of them , I like their characters . Just one . / Nice likes to tease people . He just did it earlier .

translations.ja: 全員について話せるよ、みんなのキャラが好きだから。1人だけね。／ ナイスは人をからかうのが好きなんだ。さっきもやってたし。
translations.en: I can talk about all of them, I like their characters. Just one. / Nice likes to tease people. He just did it earlier.
translations.ko: 다들 성격이 마음에 들어서 누구든 얘기할 수 있어요. 딱 한 명만요. / 나이스는 남 놀리는 걸 좋아해요. 아까도 그랬잖아요.
translations.zh-TW: 我對他們每個人都可以說，我喜歡他們的性格。只要一個。／Nice 喜歡捉弄人。他剛剛就這麼做了。
translations.id: Aku bisa membicarakan semuanya, aku suka karakter mereka. Hanya satu. / Nice suka menggoda orang. Dia baru saja melakukannya tadi.
translations.pt: Eu posso falar sobre todos eles, gosto das personalidades deles. Apenas um. / O Nice gosta de provocar as pessoas. Ele acabou de fazer isso.

transcript.text: I was serious earlier. / But it's true, Porsche is a cute guy. What's the tea on Daou? I don't know if I can say it. / Just say it.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アイ・ワズ・シリアス・アーリアー・バット・イッツ・トゥルー・ポルシェ・イズ・ア・キュート・ガイ・ワッツ・ザ・ティー・オン・ダーオ・アイ・ドント・ノウ・イフ・アイ・キャン・セイ・イット・ジャスト・セイ・イット
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I was serious earlier . / But it 's true , Porsche is a cute guy . What 's the tea on Daou ? I don 't know if I can say it . / Just say it .

translations.ja: さっきのは本気だったよ。／ でも本当だよ、ポルシェはかわいいやつなんだ。ダーオの暴露話は何？言っていいか迷うな。／ いいから言っちゃってよ。
translations.en: I was serious earlier. / But it's true, Porsche is a cute guy. What's the tea on Daou? I don't know if I can say it. / Just say it.
translations.ko: 아까는 진지했어요. / 하지만 포쉬가 귀여운 애라는 건 사실이죠. 다우에 대한 썰은요? 말해도 될지 모르겠네. / 그냥 말해봐요.
translations.zh-TW: 我剛剛是認真的。／但這是真的，Porsche 是個可愛的男生。Daou 有什麼八卦？我不知道能不能說。／說出來吧。
translations.id: Aku serius tadi. / Tapi itu benar, Porsche adalah cowok yang imut. Apa rahasia tentang Daou? Aku tidak tahu apakah aku bisa mengatakannya. / Katakan saja.
translations.pt: Eu estava falando sério agora pouco. / Mas é verdade, o Porsche é um cara fofo. Qual é a fofoca sobre o Daou? Não sei se posso dizer. / Apenas diga.

transcript.text: Okay, got it.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: オッケー・ガット・イット
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Okay , got it .

translations.ja: オッケー、わかった。
translations.en: Okay, got it.
translations.ko: 알겠습니다, 접수했어요.
translations.zh-TW: 好，知道了。
translations.id: Baiklah, mengerti.
translations.pt: Ok, entendi.

transcript.text: While we were waiting to shoot something, we stood so close…. / I'm anticipating on this.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ワイル・ウィー・ワー・ウェイティング・トゥ・シュート・サムシング・ウィー・ストゥッド・ソー・クロース・アイム・アンティシペイティング・オン・ディス
transcript.pronunciation_roman: While we were waiting to shoot something , we stood so close …. / I 'm anticipating on this .

translations.ja: 撮影を待ってる間、僕たちすごく近くに立ってたんだけど…。／ これ、めっちゃ楽しみだな。
translations.en: While we were waiting to shoot something, we stood so close…. / I'm anticipating on this.
translations.ko: 촬영 대기하면서 아주 가까이 서 있었는데… / 이거 아주 기대되는데요.
translations.zh-TW: 當我們等待拍攝時，我們站得好近……／我好期待這個。
